One of them is Xiono.|[[Hera Syndulla]] and Vic Hawkins discussing Chancellor Mon Mothma|}} [[Lieutenant]] '''Vic Hawkins''' was a [[Executive officer|First Officer]] in the [[New Republic]]'s [[New Republic Defense Fleet|Defense Fleet]] in [[9 ABY]].{{AhsokaSeriesDate}} serving aboard ''[[Home One]]'' under [[General]] [[Hera Syndulla]].{{Ahsoka|Part Three: Time to Fly}} {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== Vic Hawkins was portrayed by the actor [[Nican Robinson]]. He was first shown in the first teaser trailer for [[Star Wars: Ahsoka|''Ahsoka'']], which was uploaded to the official ''[[Star Wars]]'' YouTube channel on [[April 7]], [[2023]].{{SWYouTube|HnzNZ0Mdx4I|Ahsoka | Teaser Trailer | Disney+|sw_url=video/ahsoka-teaser-trailer}} They were first identified with the announcement of the [[LEGO]] set [[w:c:brickipedia:75357 Ghost & Phantom II|75357 Ghost & Phantom II]], which was released on [[September 1]], [[2023]].
